scripts.otel:jaeger:delete: kubectl delete deployment,svc -l app=jaeger -n observability || true
scripts.otel:collector:delete: kubectl delete deployment,configmap,svc -l app=otel-collector -n observability || true
scripts.otel:redeploy:all: npm run otel:delete:all && npm run otel:deploy:all && npm run otel:verify:pods
scripts.otel:delete:all: kubectl delete -f devops/k8s/observability/otel-collector.yaml --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete -f devops/k8s/observability/otel-jaeger.yaml --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete namespace observability --ignore-not-found
scripts.otel:deploy:all: kubectl apply -f devops/k8s/base/namespace.yaml && kubectl apply -f devops/k8s/observability/otel-jaeger.yaml && kubectl apply -f devops/k8s/observability/otel-collector.yaml
scripts.otel:jaeger:ui-k8s: bash -c 'PORT=$(kubectl get svc -n observability -l app=jaeger -o jsonpath="{.items[0].spec.ports[0].nodePort}"); echo Jaeger UI: http://localhost:$PORT && open http://localhost:$PORT'
scripts.kubectl:local-redeploy: npm run docker:build && npm run kubectl:local-delete && npm run kubectl:local-deploy
scripts.kubectl:local-nodeport: bash -c 'PORT=$(kubectl get svc local-spring-k8s-cache-webhook-coordinator -o jsonpath="{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}"); echo App URL: http://localhost:$PORT && open http://localhost:$PORT'
scripts.app:apis:test: bash -c 'PORT=$(kubectl get svc local-spring-k8s-cache-webhook-coordinator -o jsonpath="{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}"); echo Invoking trace on http://localhost:$PORT/trace/test && curl -X GET http://localhost:$PORT/trace/test -v'
scripts.app:apis:clearCache: bash -c 'PORT=$(kubectl get svc local-spring-k8s-cache-webhook-coordinator -o jsonpath="{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}"); echo Invoking trace on http://localhost:$PORT/cache-manager/v1/clearCache && curl -X GET http://localhost:$PORT/cache-manager/v1/clearCache -v'
scripts.app:trace:test:ui: npm run app:apis:test && npm run otel:jaeger:ui-k8s
scripts.kubectl:local-open-spring-boot-app-url: bash -c 'PORT=$(kubectl get svc local-spring-k8s-cache-webhook-coordinator -o jsonpath="{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}"); echo Spring Boot App Health: http://localhost:$PORT/actuator/health && open http://localhost:$PORT/actuator/health'
scripts.kubectl:clean:all: kubectl delete all -l app=spring-k8s-cache-webhook-coordinator --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete namespace observability --ignore-not-found
scripts.kubectl:local-clean-redeploy: npm run kubectl:clean:all && kubectl delete all,configmap,secret,serviceaccount,clusterrole,clusterrolebinding -l app=spring-k8s-cache-webhook-coordinator --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete -k devops/k8s/overlays/local --ignore-not-found  && npm run docker:stop || true && npm run docker:rm || true  && docker rmi spring-k8s-cache-webhook-coordinator || true && npm run build  && npm run docker:build  && kubectl apply -k devops/k8s/overlays/local && npm run otel:redeploy:all
scripts.kubectl:local-clean-redeploy-open-ui: npm run kubectl:local-clean-redeploy && echo 'Sleeping for 5 seconds to open Jaeger UI' && sleep 5 && npm run kubectl:local-open-ui && echo 'Sleeping for 15 seconds to open Spring Boot App URL' && sleep 15 && npm run kubectl:local-open-spring-boot-app-url
